end.parentNote: Asha used a story and step-by-step prompts to practise the levels of organisation. Yash explained that similar cells work together to form a tissue and completed two of three attempts without help. They left the final “organism” incomplete in one response, and it was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask them to arrange five cards—cell, tissue, organ, organ system, organism—and explain each step aloud.
